title: An unsent rejoin is uncounted, so the next ingest tick retries the same attempt with no ceiling
trigger: A group call drops (need_rejoin) and the TDLib client cannot take the joinVideoChat send (client closing, native send error) after the native offer is built
effect: attempt_unsent sets Wanted{attempts: attempt-1}; maybe_auto_rejoin_group_call sees next_attempt() == Some on every ingest tick, so each tick allocates a request, leaves and re-creates the native group context and drains the stream feeder, until the call or client goes away. The MAX_GROUP_CALL_REJOIN_ATTEMPTS cap never applies to this path.
fix: Count an unsent attempt (or add GroupCallRejoin::Unsent{at,tries} with a back-off like ProxyFetch::NotSent) so a send that cannot leave is retried on a clock and capped

title: Watch::Watching names a detached watcher thread but holds no task or handle
trigger: On Linux, running() starts the quill-screen-reader thread once and later restarts it only through Watch::ended, which the thread's own EndGuard calls
effect: No bug today (EndGuard ends the stage on every exit, a panic included). The stage is Watching{misses} with the thread detached, the in-flight-variant-holds-no-task shape. Only the guard's drop moves the stage out of Watching, so a thread that hangs forever in the zbus iterator is never replaced, and ON stays at its last value.
fix: Hold the JoinHandle or a TaskHold in Watching and settle the stage from it, or allow-list it as a process-wide singleton with that reason

title: RequestAcks.settled is only emptied by take/forget; an answer nobody takes stays for the session
trigger: A caller calls expect(id), the answer arrives and settle() stores it, then the owner (box, window, account) goes away before it calls take(id)
effect: The settled map keeps the Answer for the life of the Session; unbounded only by how many abandoned requests there are, so a slow leak, not a visible bug
fix: Key the acks to the owner so closing the owner calls forget, or cap/age the settled map as Answers<T> does with KEPT

title: unique_dir pushes every directory onto the at-exit list and never removes finished ones
trigger: A long session calls unique_dir/remove_at_exit many times (per-send photo edits, sticker work)
effect: DIRS grows for the life of the process and the at-exit sweep removes them all together; disk use of finished work folders is only reclaimed at exit or by the 24 h sweep
fix: Return an owned guard (OwnedFile-style) that removes its folder on drop and deregisters it

title: A UI shutdown answers a waiting second launch as delivered
trigger: A second Quill launch forwards its args and waits for the UI heartbeat; the first instance quits (Heartbeat::stop) before it beats
effect: stop() replaces Running{waiting} with NotRunning, dropping the senders; answered_by treats Disconnected as answered, so the second launch exits as Forwarded and the queued link/file is lost with the quitting instance
fix: Make a dropped waiter a separate answer (Gone) that acquire retries as Verdict::Gone does, not Delivered
